a02Resolution.question: why rotate the gateway credential at all, given Magpie compatibility is done
a02Resolution.answer: Magpie compatibility is complete - configured key or bearer token, header environment references, real task and resume validated - and rotation is an action the application's own administrative surface performs, not a harness feature. The half that was still listed as an item is therefore closed as not-a-requirement rather than as work in progress.

publicationFixes.what: an OpenAI-shaped fixture was assembled instead of written out
publicationFixes.detail: GitHub push protection refused the first push because test/credential-shapes.test.ts carried the literal marker the OpenAI key scanner looks for. The sample is padding, not a credential, but a public checkout should not contain a key-shaped literal at all, so the fixture is now joined from its parts: the value the test sees is identical and the file no longer trips a scanner.
